name: unprotected

reference.root_cause: changeOwner() has no access-control modifier. Anyone can call it and set themselves (or any address) as the owner, since `onlyowner` is defined but never applied to the state-changing function.
reference.impact: Full loss of privileged control over the contract; the attacker becomes the owner and can perform any owner-only action.
reference.exploit: Call changeOwner(attackerAddress) from any wallet; the owner is overwritten with no authorization check.
reference.fix: Apply the `onlyowner` modifier to changeOwner (as in changeOwner_fixed), or use OpenZeppelin Ownable with onlyOwner.
